description: Files engine on S3 through an S3-compatible endpoint (path-style): SigV4 signing with credentials from an STS AssumeRole call (form post signed for sts, XML answer), ListObjectsV2 paged with a continuation token that needs encoding, folder markers and a file outside the include globs skipped, a key with a space, CSV, JSON, JSON Lines and Avro (header schema with a nullable union, logical types, an array and a three-way union) inferred from ranged reads, object tags (objectTags on) and the bucket ACL as grants.
